name: Infinite Stars - 23rd Annual Halloween Heist
source:
It's the 23rd Annual Spooktober Halloween Heist, and the crew from the UIC Tabitha are up to no good!

Meet up with old friends in new outfits and have some light-hearted fun with a few of your favourite Infinite Stars characters!

[From [url=https://infinitestars.itch.io/infinite-stars-23rd-annual-halloween-heist]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
第23届年度Spooktober万圣节抢劫活动即将来临，UIC Tabitha的船员们正图谋不轨！

穿着新服装与老朋友见面，并与你最喜欢的《无限星辰》角色一起享受轻松的乐趣！

[来自[url=https://infinitestars.itch.io/infinite-stars-23rd-annual-halloween-heist]itch.io[/url]]
